name: One Night Love
source: A male climber was separated from his friends. He got lost in the mountain until the night. He was scared of dark, but it's gone when he met a mysterious girl in the mountain who willing to help him get out from there.
translation: 一名男性登山者与他的朋友失散。他在山里迷路了，直到晚上。他本来很怕黑，但当他在山里遇到了一位神秘的女孩，愿意帮助他离开那里时，一切就都消失了。
